notes: Create these API names in Steamworks after the real App ID exists. Keep API names stable once published.

stats.description: Total completed buy or sell orders.
Sell orders closed above the position average cost.
Months ended with positive portfolio performance.
Completed Academy lessons across all categories.
Contacts met through the Network app.

achievements.description: Place your first buy or sell order.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock after any successful GameManager buy_lots or sell_lots result.

achievements.description: Close a position for a profit.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock when a sell order realizes profit above average cost.

achievements.description: Add your first stock to the watchlist.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock when a watchlist add succeeds.

achievements.description: Open your first News article.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock when the player opens a News article detail.

achievements.description: Inspect a company's Key Stats.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock when the player opens the Key Stats tab for any stock.

achievements.description: Mark your first chart pattern.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock when ChartPatternSystem accepts a player pattern claim.

achievements.description: Create your first thesis.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock when a thesis record is created.

achievements.description: Buy your first upgrade.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock when an upgrade purchase succeeds.

achievements.description: Meet your first Network contact.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock when Network contact meet action succeeds.

achievements.description: Receive your first Network tip.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock when a Network tip is created for the player.

achievements.description: Attend an interactive RUPSLB meeting.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock when an interactive RUPSLB overlay reaches attendance state.

achievements.description: Reach the end of your first trading month.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock after the first monthly life-payment cycle or day 20+.

achievements.description: Finish a month with positive portfolio performance.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock when a month-end portfolio snapshot is above its month-start value.

achievements.description: Recover your portfolio after a meaningful drawdown.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock after equity recovers above prior high following a 10% drawdown.

achievements.description: Complete your first Academy lesson.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock when the first Academy lesson completion is recorded.

achievements.description: Complete the first technical-analysis lesson path.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock when the technical Academy category completion flag is set.

achievements.description: Survive one month on Normal difficulty.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock at day 20+ when current difficulty id is normal.

achievements.description: Survive one month on Grind difficulty.
achievements.trigger_note: Unlock at day 20+ when current difficulty id is grind.

achievements.description: Live through a sharp speculative move and stay solvent.
achievements.trigger_note: Optional hidden unlock when a held gorengan/speculative stock hits a major down move and portfolio cash stays non-negative.

achievements.description: Gain majority control of a company.
achievements.trigger_note: Optional hidden unlock when player ownership crosses the majority-control threshold.
